name: agent-skills
title_zh: 把 Addy Osmani 的工程实战经验装进你的编
tagline_zh: 面对生产级代码不再靠猜。这是 Chrome 前工程总监沉淀的 skill 合集，覆盖从代码审查到性能剖析的真实工程。
tagline_en: Stop guessing at production code. A battle-tested skill pack from Chrome's former engineering director — covering.
desc_en: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents by Addy Osmani
why_zh: 不是零散提示词，而是按工程流程组织的 skill 体系。每个 skill 都经过真实项目验证。
why_en: Not random prompts, but a structured skill system mapped to real engineering workflows. Each skill encodes proven practices.
limit_zh: 仅适用于编码类 Agent（如 Claude Code、Cursor）。不包含 UI 设计、运维部署等非编码域。
limit_en: For coding agents only (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor). No UI/ops coverage. Skills provide checklists & flows, not auto-fixes; complex architecture.
title_en: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
